title: <run-dir>/<issue>/ac-checklist.json
description: Shape is normative here; semantics live in ../ac-checklist.md. readAcComplete (bin/lib/merge-gate.js) accepts either the canonical `all_verified` key or the legacy `ac_complete` alternative — both documented, either satisfies the merge_floor leg. This subset validator has no anyOf, so the schema requires the canonical key; a legacy-only file (ac_complete, no all_verified) is a real accepted shape the schema does not close on (additionalProperties: true covers it) — see the page's Integrity section for the discrepancy.

all_verified.description: canonical key — true only when every auto-verifiable AC is ticked

ac_complete.description: legacy-accepted alternative key; readAcComplete treats it identically to all_verified
